crossRefs.note: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. Yahweh, you preserve man and…
who gives food to every creature; for his loving kindness endures forever.
The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more…

translations.web: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
translations.bsb: All creatures look to You to give them their food in due season.
translations.kjv: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.
translations.asv: These wait all for thee, That thou mayest give them their food in due season.
